deadline_note: HKU international-qualifications page: applications for 2027 entry open 23 Sept 2026; submit by 25 Nov 2026 (noon HKT) for first-round evaluation, then rolling review; applications close 25 Aug 2027.

aid_intl.en: Entrance scholarships for non-local students are awarded on merit through the HKU Scholarships Office (the admissions site lists dozens matching non-local applicants); no need-blind aid for international students.

tests.en: SAT/ACT and AP are accepted as part of US-curriculum qualifications; IB, A-level and many national diplomas accepted. Applicants whose school language is not English must meet HKU's English language requirement (IELTS/TOEFL and others; see the official page).

summary.en: Hong Kong's oldest university and the highest-ranked in the city (QS #11 in 2026), teaching in English. Non-local students apply directly online, with a first-round deadline in late November.
summary.ka: ჰონკონგის უძველესი და ყველაზე მაღალრეიტინგული უნივერსიტეტი (QS 2026 — მე-11 ადგილი), სწავლება ინგლისურ ენაზე მიმდინარეობს. უცხოელი აპლიკანტები პირდაპირ ონლაინ აპლიკაციით აბარებენ; პირველი რაუნდის ვადა ნოემბრის ბოლოსაა.
summary.ar: أقدم جامعات هونغ كونغ وأعلاها تصنيفاً (المرتبة 11 في QS 2026)، والتدريس فيها بالإنجليزية. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون مباشرة عبر الإنترنت، وينتهي الموعد الأول في أواخر نوفمبر.

about.en:
Founded in 1911, HKU is a comprehensive research university on Hong Kong Island with ten faculties, strong professional schools (medicine, law, dentistry, architecture) and an English-medium curriculum built around a common core. It recruits heavily from mainland China, Asia and beyond, and its graduates are well placed for careers in finance, law and research across Asia.

Non-local applicants with IB, A-levels, US high-school diplomas (with SAT/ACT/AP) or other national qualifications apply through HKU's own online system. Submitting by the late-November first-round date gives the earliest decisions; later applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Fees are high for non-locals, so check the merit entrance scholarships early.

name.en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)

deadline_note: CUHK Important Dates (2027 admissions): applications open 2 Oct 2026; Advance Offer Round deadline 12 Nov 2026; Regular Round deadline 7 Jan 2027.

tuition_intl.note: 2027-28 non-local fee HK$230,000; yearly adjustment for the 2027 cohort capped at 3%. Dual-degree fees may vary.

aid_intl.en: Admission scholarships (merit-based) are open to non-local undergraduates; CUHK also runs financial aid schemes. Details on the Scholarships page.

tests.en: Minimum SAT 1190 / ACT 24 for US-pattern applicants (plus AP tests). English: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before 21 Jan 2026; 4.5/6 on the new TOEFL scale), or SAT EBRW 590 / ACT ELA 23. IELTS Online, One Skill Retake and TOEFL Home Edition are not accepted.

sat.note: Minimum for US high-school diploma applicants

summary.en: A leading bilingual research university with a collegiate system on a large campus in Sha Tin. International applicants apply directly; the Advance Offer Round closes 12 November 2026.
summary.ka: წამყვანი ორენოვანი კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი კოლეჯების სისტემით, დიდ კამპუსზე შა-ტინში. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტები პირდაპირ აბარებენ; ადრეული შეთავაზების რაუნდის ვადაა 2026 წლის 12 ნოემბერი.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية رائدة ثنائية اللغة تعتمد نظام الكليات السكنية في حرم واسع بمنطقة شا تين. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون مباشرة، وينتهي موعد جولة العروض المبكرة في 12 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
CUHK, founded in 1963, is a comprehensive research university with nine colleges that give students a smaller residential community within a large campus. It is especially strong in medicine, business, engineering, translation and journalism, and most undergraduate programmes are taught in English or bilingually.

Non-local applicants with IB, A-levels, US diplomas plus SAT/ACT, or other national qualifications apply through CUHK's own portal. Applying in the Advance Offer Round (by 12 November) brings decisions from December; everyone else competes in the Regular Round (deadline 7 January). Successful applicants pay a HK$10,000 first instalment to accept their place.

name.en: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)

deadline_note: HKUST application procedures: system opens 2 Oct 2026; Priority Round deadline 25 Nov 2026; rolling review from 26 Nov; applications close 30 Jun 2027.

aid_intl.en: Admission scholarships are considered automatically (University Admissions Scholarship for Other Qualifications, Global Learners Scholarship, Olympiad Medalist scheme); the Future Leaders Award and Beyond Academic Admissions Scholarship need a separate application.

tests.en: SAT, ACT and AP are accepted with US-curriculum diplomas. English proof required: IELTS Academic, TOEFL, Duolingo, PTE and others are accepted (minimums shown per test on the International Qualifications page). Application fee HK$600.

summary.en: A young, research-intensive university on Clear Water Bay, known for engineering, AI and business. International students apply directly; the Priority Round deadline is 25 November 2026.
summary.ka: ახალგაზრდა, კვლევაზე ორიენტირებული უნივერსიტეტი Clear Water Bay-ზე, ცნობილი ინჟინერიით, ხელოვნური ინტელექტითა და ბიზნესით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები პირდაპირ აბარებენ; პრიორიტეტული რაუნდის ვადაა 2026 წლის 25 ნოემბერი.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية حديثة نسبياً تطل على خليج كلير ووتر، معروفة بالهندسة والذكاء الاصطناعي وإدارة الأعمال. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون مباشرة، وآخر موعد للجولة ذات الأولوية 25 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
HKUST opened in 1991 and rose quickly into the world top 50 on the strength of its engineering, science and business schools. Teaching is in English, the campus is residential, and there are interdisciplinary options such as the Technology and Management dual degree and an Individualized Interdisciplinary Major.

Non-local applicants submit one online application with a personal statement, school reports from Grade 10, proof of English and an academic referee. Applying by the Priority Round (25 November) gives the earliest offers; the system stays open until June on a rolling basis.

label.ka: ინგლისური ენის ტესტი (IELTS / TOEFL / Duolingo / PTE)
label.ar: اختبار اللغة الإنجليزية (IELTS / TOEFL / Duolingo / PTE)

deadline_note: PolyU international admissions page lists "Application Deadline: 17 Nov 2026" for Sept 2027 programmes (early round); later main/extended rounds are announced on the Key Dates page.

tuition_intl.note: Non-local tuition (about US$30,769); PolyU estimates total yearly spending around HK$330,272. First-year hall place normally granted for the 2027/28 cohort.

aid_intl.en: Undergraduate entrance scholarships for non-local students are listed on the PolyU Fees and Scholarships pages.

tests.en: International qualifications (IB, A-level, SAT/AP, national diplomas) accepted; applicants from non-English-medium schools need an English test (see PolyU English requirements page).

summary.en: Hong Kong's applied university, known for hotel and tourism management, design, engineering and health sciences. Non-local applicants apply online; the first 2027 deadline is 17 November 2026.
summary.ka: ჰონკონგის გამოყენებითი მეცნიერებების უნივერსიტეტი, ცნობილი სასტუმრო-ტურიზმის მენეჯმენტით, დიზაინით, ინჟინერიითა და ჯანდაცვით. უცხოელები ონლაინ აბარებენ; 2027 წლის პირველი ვადაა 2026 წლის 17 ნოემბერი.
summary.ar: جامعة تطبيقية في هونغ كونغ تشتهر بإدارة الفنادق والسياحة والتصميم والهندسة والعلوم الصحية. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون عبر الإنترنت، وأول موعد نهائي لدخول 2027 هو 17 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
PolyU in Hung Hom, Kowloon, is a large public university with a practical, industry-linked approach. Its School of Hotel and Tourism Management and School of Design are among the best known in Asia, and it also has strong engineering, rehabilitation sciences, nursing and accounting programmes, all taught in English.

Non-local students apply through the eAdmission system with IB, A-levels, SAT/AP or other recognised qualifications. Non-local first-year students are normally offered a hall place; from year two they arrange housing themselves, which matters for budgeting in Hong Kong.

deadline_note: HKBU runs an Early Round (offers from late Dec 2026; unsuccessful early applicants move to the Main Round after late Jan 2027). Exact 2027 round deadlines are on the international qualifications page.

aid_intl.en: Admission scholarships are awarded on academic and non-academic merit with no separate application.

tests.en: SAT minimum 1190 (new SAT) for US-pattern applicants; AP grade 3 in two subjects. English: TOEFL iBT 79 or IELTS Academic 6.0 (from 2027 entry the test must be taken on or after 1 Sept 2025), or SAT EBRW 590.

summary.en: A liberal-arts-style public university in Kowloon Tong, strongest in communication, film, the arts and Chinese medicine. International applicants apply directly through Early and Main Rounds.
summary.ka: ლიბერალური ხელოვნების სტილის საჯარო უნივერსიტეტი Kowloon Tong-ში, განსაკუთრებით ძლიერი კომუნიკაციაში, კინოში, ხელოვნებასა და ჩინურ მედიცინაში. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტები პირდაპირ აბარებენ ადრეულ და ძირითად რაუნდებში.
summary.ar: جامعة حكومية ذات طابع الفنون الحرة في كاولون تونغ، أقوى مجالاتها الاتصال والسينما والفنون والطب الصيني. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون مباشرة عبر جولة مبكرة وجولة رئيسية.

about.en:
HKBU describes itself as one of Asia's leading liberal-arts universities, with English-medium teaching, low staff-to-student ratios and a close community. It is known for its Academy of Film, School of Communication, Academy of Visual Arts and School of Chinese Medicine, plus business and science programmes.

Applications received in the Early Round are assessed first, with offers from late December; others are considered with the Main Round. The admission scholarships need no separate application, and the university offers overseas internships, exchange and entrepreneurship bootcamps.

name.en: KAIST (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology)
name.ka: KAIST (კორეის მეცნიერებისა და ტექნოლოგიების მოწინავე ინსტიტუტი)

deadline_note: KAIST 2027 timeline: Early round (Spring or Fall 2027) ran 22 Sep - 22 Oct 2026 and has closed; Regular round (Fall 2027) runs 10 Nov 2026 - 14 Jan 2027, 6 pm KST, recommendation letters by 21 Jan 2027, online interviews if required around 25 Mar 2027.

aid_intl.en: Every admitted international undergraduate who ticks "KAIST scholarship" on the application receives full tuition exemption for 8 semesters plus KRW 350,000 a month for living costs (GPA of 2.7/4.3 must be kept after the first year). No separate scholarship application.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement is stated on the eligibility page. Proof of English (or Korean) proficiency is set out in the application guide. Applicants must hold foreign citizenship, and neither parent may be a Korean citizen (special rules apply to applicants of Korean origin).

summary.en: Korea's leading science and engineering university in Daejeon, teaching mainly in English. Every admitted international undergraduate gets a full-tuition scholarship plus a monthly allowance.
summary.ka: კორეის წამყვანი საინჟინრო და საბუნებისმეტყველო უნივერსიტეტი დეჯონში, სწავლება ძირითადად ინგლისურადაა. ყველა მიღებული საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრი იღებს სრულ სასწავლო სტიპენდიას და ყოველთვიურ დახმარებას.
summary.ar: أبرز جامعة كورية في العلوم والهندسة، مقرها دايجون، والتدريس فيها بالإنجليزية غالباً. يحصل كل طالب دولي مقبول في البكالوريوس على منحة تغطي الرسوم كاملة مع مخصص شهري.

about.en:
KAIST was founded in 1971 as Korea's first research-oriented science and engineering institution and is now one of Asia's top technical universities. Freshmen enter without a declared major and choose any department at the end of their second semester, with no quota per major, which suits students who want to explore before specialising.

International applicants apply online in an Early round (autumn) or a Regular round (November to mid-January), submit school records, essays and a recommendation letter, and may be interviewed online. The KAIST Scholarship covers full tuition for eight semesters and KRW 350,000 a month, making it one of the most generous undergraduate offers in Asia.

deadline_note: AUD admits on a rolling basis for Fall, Spring and summer sessions; semester dates are on the Academic Calendar & Application Deadlines page. Apply early for scholarships.

aid_intl.en: H.H. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum Scholarship: partial or full tuition waiver for high-school applicants with at least a 90% average, with financial need also considered; further merit and athletic scholarships via the AUD scholarship portal.

tests.en: English: IELTS Academic 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 79 (TOEFL ITP 550) for full admission; IELTS 6.0 / iBT 68 / ITP 520 gives admission with a developmental English course. Math proficiency by SAT or AUD placement test (SAT code 2688). IB/A-level/AP can exempt you from tests. Application fee AED 420; AED 5,000 seat deposit on acceptance.

summary.en: A US-accredited private university in Dubai Media City offering American-style degrees in business, engineering, design and communication. Admission is rolling, with Fall, Spring and summer starts.
summary.ka: აშშ-ში აკრედიტებული კერძო უნივერსიტეტი Dubai Media City-ში, ამერიკული ტიპის ხარისხებით ბიზნესში, ინჟინერიაში, დიზაინსა და კომუნიკაციაში. მიღება უწყვეტია: შემოდგომის, გაზაფხულისა და ზაფხულის ნაკადებით.
summary.ar: جامعة خاصة معتمدة أمريكياً في مدينة دبي للإعلام تقدم شهادات على النمط الأمريكي في الأعمال والهندسة والتصميم والاتصال. القبول مستمر مع بدايات في الخريف والربيع والصيف.

about.en:
AUD has taught a US-style liberal-arts-based curriculum in Dubai since 1995 and is accredited in the United States (SACSCOC) as well as by the UAE Commission for Academic Accreditation. Its schools cover business, engineering, architecture and design, communication and arts and sciences, and the student body is highly international.

Applicants submit attested school transcripts for the last three years, an English test and math evidence; strong students from IB, A-level or AP backgrounds may be exempt from tests. Tuition is charged per credit (see the Office of Finance), and high achievers with a 90%+ average can apply for the Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid scholarship covering part or all of tuition.

aid_intl.en: Scholarships and discounts are handled by the Office of Scholarship & Financial Aid (academic merit, siblings, sports and others).

tests.en: English-taught programmes: 80% in Grade 12 English, or IELTS Academic 5.0 / TOEFL iBT 61 (ITP 500). Doctor of Medicine: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 79. Subject minimums: 90% in maths and two sciences for medicine and dentistry; 80% for engineering and pharmacy; 70-75% maths for IT, AI, law and IS.

summary.en: A large private university in Ajman, one of the highest-ranked private universities in the UAE, with medicine, dentistry, engineering and AI programmes. English requirements start at IELTS 5.0.
summary.ka: დიდი კერძო უნივერსიტეტი აჯმანში, არაბთა საამიროების ერთ-ერთი მაღალრეიტინგული კერძო უნივერსიტეტი, მედიცინის, სტომატოლოგიის, ინჟინერიისა და ხელოვნური ინტელექტის პროგრამებით. ინგლისურის მოთხოვნა IELTS 5.0-დან იწყება.
summary.ar: جامعة خاصة كبيرة في عجمان، من أعلى الجامعات الخاصة تصنيفاً في الإمارات، تقدم برامج الطب وطب الأسنان والهندسة والذكاء الاصطناعي. يبدأ شرط اللغة الإنجليزية من IELTS 5.0.

about.en:
Founded in 1988, Ajman University has around ten colleges, from medicine, dentistry and pharmacy to engineering, IT, business, law and mass communication, on a campus in the northern emirates. It is popular with Gulf and Arab students and also enrols students from across Asia and Africa.

Admission is based on high-school results with subject minimums per programme and an English test for English-taught degrees. Fees are listed per programme on the undergraduate tuition page for 2026-27, and the scholarship office offers merit and family discounts.

English proof: IELTS Academic 5.0 or TOEFL iBT 64 (valid 2 years) or equivalent; some majors may require an English proficiency exam.

summary.en: Sorbonne University's branch on Al Reem Island awards French degrees, mostly taught in French, with an intensive French year for beginners. It is a route to a Sorbonne degree in the Gulf.
summary.ka: სორბონის უნივერსიტეტის ფილიალი ალ-რიმის კუნძულზე გასცემს ფრანგულ დიპლომებს; სწავლება ძირითადად ფრანგულადაა, დამწყებთათვის კი ინტენსიური ფრანგულის წელია. ეს არის სორბონის ხარისხის მიღების გზა სპარსეთის ყურის რეგიონში.
summary.ar: فرع جامعة السوربون في جزيرة الريم يمنح شهادات فرنسية يُدرَّس معظمها بالفرنسية، مع سنة فرنسية مكثفة للمبتدئين. وهو طريق للحصول على شهادة السوربون في الخليج.

about.en:
Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi (SUAD) was set up in 2006 through an agreement between the Abu Dhabi government and Sorbonne University in Paris. Degrees are awarded by Sorbonne University and follow the Paris curricula in law, economics and management, humanities, sciences and archival studies.

Applicants submit a personal statement (in French for French-taught bachelor's, in English for the intensive French diploma and some science degrees), transcripts, passport, photo and English evidence. Students without French can start with the Diploma in Intensive French before entering a bachelor's.

deadline_note: Deadlines are announced per semester on the ZU admissions pages; none for Fall 2027 published yet.

tuition_intl.note: International (non-national) undergraduates pay AED 2,500 per credit hour; application fee AED 250 + VAT.

aid_intl.en: UAE nationals on the government scheme study tuition-free; international students pay per credit, with installment plans.

tests.en: Programme-specific: e.g. 80% in Grade 12 English or TOEFL iBT 72 and 80% maths or SAT Math 530 for business/IT; 85% English or TOEFL iBT 79 and SAT Math 590 for more technical majors. TOEFL Home Edition not accepted.

summary.en: A federal UAE university with campuses in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, focused on communication, international studies, business, IT and design. International students pay AED 2,500 per credit hour.
summary.ka: არაბთა საამიროების ფედერალური უნივერსიტეტი კამპუსებით აბუ-დაბისა და დუბაიში, ორიენტირებული კომუნიკაციაზე, საერთაშორისო ურთიერთობებზე, ბიზნესზე, IT-სა და დიზაინზე. უცხოელები კრედიტზე 2 500 დირჰამს იხდიან.
summary.ar: جامعة اتحادية إماراتية لها حرمان في أبوظبي ودبي، تركز على الاتصال والدراسات الدولية والأعمال وتقنية المعلومات والتصميم. يدفع الطلاب الدوليون 2,500 درهم للساعة المعتمدة.

about.en:
Zayed University, founded in 1998 and named after the UAE's founding president, is one of three federal universities. Teaching is in English across colleges of communication and media, humanities and social sciences, business, technological innovation, arts and creative enterprises, and natural and health sciences.

Admission is competitive and based on Grade 12 results with programme-specific minimums in English, maths and sciences, which can be met by TOEFL and SAT Math scores. Most students are Emirati; international students are admitted as self-funded students paying per credit hour.

aid_intl.en: Merit and need-based scholarships listed on the CUD Scholarships page, including the SUN student scholarships.

tests.en: Non-UAE curricula taught in English: IELTS Academic 5.0 / TOEFL iBT 61 / ITP 500 (Creative Industries: IELTS 5.5 / iBT 71). IELTS Online and TOEFL Home Edition not accepted. Math placement test unless SAT Math 450+ or 70% UAE maths; 80% in English for UAE curriculum applicants.

summary.en: A private university in Dubai offering Canadian-style degrees and pathways to partner universities in Canada. Admission is rolling, with an international deadline of 3 January 2027 for the Spring intake.
summary.ka: კერძო უნივერსიტეტი დუბაიში კანადური ტიპის პროგრამებითა და კანადის პარტნიორ უნივერსიტეტებში გადასვლის შესაძლებლობით. მიღება უწყვეტია; გაზაფხულის ნაკადისთვის უცხოელთა ვადაა 2027 წლის 3 იანვარი.
summary.ar: جامعة خاصة في دبي تقدم برامج على النمط الكندي ومسارات انتقال إلى جامعات شريكة في كندا. القبول مستمر، وآخر موعد للطلاب الدوليين لدفعة الربيع هو 3 يناير 2027.

about.en:
Canadian University Dubai, on Sheikh Zayed Road, follows a Canadian curriculum model and has articulation agreements that let students complete part of their studies at partner universities in Canada. It offers bachelor's degrees in business, engineering, architecture and interior design, communication, computing, environmental health and creative industries.

Entry requires a recognised high-school certificate (with UAE equivalency), an English test and a math placement test or SAT Math. CUD takes students in Fall, Spring and Summer, and students who miss the English score can start in its English for Academic Purposes programme.

deadline_note: Applications are accepted during admission periods announced on the UAEU website and academic calendar; no fixed Fall 2027 date published yet.

aid_intl.en: Chancellor's Scholarship for Elite Students (100% tuition with 98%+ in Grade 12, 75% with 95%+, plus English and maths scores) and Chancellor's Scholarship for Talented Students (100% or 50% for innovation, arts, sport or technology). Tuition only; housing not covered.

tests.en: International applicants: Grade 12 average of 90% (health sciences, engineering, computing/AI, science, agriculture/veterinary) or 85% (business, humanities, education, law); English 90% in MOE Grade 12 English, or IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT 70 or TOEFL ITP 525. Applicants must be 35 or younger. The MD programme is limited to nationals and funded students.

gpa_note.en: International applicants need a 90% (STEM and health) or 85% (other colleges) high-school average.

summary.en: The UAE's first and highest-ranked national university, in Al Ain (QS #229). International students can apply with high school averages of 85-90%, and top achievers can win full-tuition Chancellor's scholarships.
summary.ka: არაბთა საამიროების პირველი და ყველაზე მაღალრეიტინგული ეროვნული უნივერსიტეტი ალ-აინში (QS 2026 — 229-ე). უცხოელებს შეუძლიათ განაცხადის შეტანა 85-90%-იანი საშუალო ქულით, საუკეთესოებს კი რექტორის სრული სასწავლო სტიპენდიის მოპოვება შეუძლიათ.
summary.ar: أول جامعة وطنية في الإمارات وأعلاها تصنيفاً، مقرها العين (المرتبة 229 في QS 2026). يمكن للطلاب الدوليين التقدم بمعدل ثانوي 85-90%، ويحصل المتفوقون على منح المستشار التي تغطي الرسوم كاملة.

about.en:
Founded in 1976, UAEU is the country's flagship federal research university, with nine colleges including engineering, medicine and health sciences, IT, science, business and economics, law, education, humanities and social sciences, and agriculture and veterinary medicine. Most programmes are taught in English and the university runs separate male and female campus facilities in Al Ain.

International students and children of UAEU employees apply online during announced admission periods with a Grade 12 certificate (plus MOE equivalency for foreign curricula) and an English test. Places for non-nationals are limited, so very strong grades matter; the Chancellor's scholarships reward 95-98%+ averages or exceptional talent.

deadline_note: Rolling admission each semester; see AAU admission pages.

aid_intl.en: High School Excellence Grants: a discount on first-semester credit-hour fees by Grade 12 average, with a 30% discount continuing for students who keep a 3.6 GPA; Dean's List academic grants; 20% sibling discounts; 40% for AAU alumni.

tests.en: English: 80% in high-school English, or IELTS 5.0, or TOEFL 500; otherwise a 3-credit remedial English course. Subject minimums apply for pharmacy, engineering and law (remedial courses possible).

summary.en: A private university with campuses in Al Ain and Abu Dhabi, offering pharmacy, dentistry, engineering, law and business degrees. Entry English is IELTS 5.0, and merit discounts reward strong school results.
summary.ka: კერძო უნივერსიტეტი კამპუსებით ალ-აინსა და აბუ-დაბიში: ფარმაცია, სტომატოლოგია, ინჟინერია, სამართალი და ბიზნესი. ინგლისურის მოთხოვნაა IELTS 5.0, ხოლო კარგ სასკოლო შედეგებზე ფასდაკლებები ვრცელდება.
summary.ar: جامعة خاصة لها حرمان في العين وأبوظبي، تقدم شهادات في الصيدلة وطب الأسنان والهندسة والقانون والأعمال. شرط الإنجليزية IELTS 5.0، وتمنح خصومات للتفوق الدراسي.

about.en:
Al Ain University was founded in 2004 and has grown into a mid-sized private university with colleges of pharmacy, dentistry, engineering and IT, law, business, education, humanities and communication across its Al Ain and Abu Dhabi campuses. Many programmes are taught in English, while law and some education programmes use Arabic.

Applicants need a recognised secondary certificate and an English score; students without it take remedial English in their first semester. The university's grants mainly take the form of percentage discounts on credit-hour fees, linked to school averages and university GPA.

name.en: Rochester Institute of Technology Dubai (RIT Dubai)

deadline_note: RIT Dubai is accepting applications for Spring and Fall 2027 on a rolling basis; late applications are reviewed subject to space, and scholarship seats are limited.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships of up to 45-50% based on high-school percentage and achievements; apply after acceptance; awards are renewed yearly. Need-based aid also available.

tests.en: High-school transcript; English test (IELTS, TOEFL or EmSAT) if available; maths and physics placement tests (SAT Math scores can place you). Engineering needs 80% in maths and two sciences.

sat.note: SAT Math used for maths placement

summary.en: The Dubai Silicon Oasis branch of the US Rochester Institute of Technology, awarding RIT degrees in engineering, computing and business. Admission is rolling for Spring and Fall 2027, with merit scholarships up to about half of tuition.
summary.ka: აშშ-ის Rochester Institute of Technology-ს ფილიალი Dubai Silicon Oasis-ში, რომელიც RIT-ის დიპლომებს გასცემს ინჟინერიაში, კომპიუტინგსა და ბიზნესში. 2027 წლის გაზაფხულისა და შემოდგომის ნაკადებზე მიღება უწყვეტია, დამსახურებაზე დაფუძნებული სტიპენდიები სწავლის საფასურის დაახლოებით ნახევრამდე ფარავს.
summary.ar: فرع معهد روتشستر للتكنولوجيا الأمريكي في واحة دبي للسيليكون، يمنح شهادات RIT في الهندسة والحوسبة والأعمال. القبول مستمر لدفعتي ربيع وخريف 2027، مع منح جدارة تصل إلى نحو نصف الرسوم.

about.en:
RIT Dubai opened in 2008 as a global campus of Rochester Institute of Technology in New York, and its graduates receive the same RIT degree. Programmes focus on engineering (electrical, mechanical), computing and cybersecurity, and business, with co-operative education (paid work placements) built into many degrees.

Applicants submit a high-school transcript and, if available, an English test; maths and physics placement tests set first-year courses. Tuition is charged per credit hour (see the tuition page), and merit scholarships are awarded after admission, so early application helps.

deadline_note: PSU announces admission windows on its admissions pages and events calendar; no Fall 2027 date published at time of checking.

tuition_intl.note: Students enrolling from 2025 onward pay SAR 3,000 per credit hour (minimum 12 credit hours per semester); application fee SAR 500.

aid_intl.en: Scholarships are applied for separately after admission (see the Scholarships section of the admissions page).

tests.en: All high-school entrants start in a one-year Preparatory Year Program. English minimum for the PYP: Qiyas English Placement Test 50, or TOEFL iBT 25 (old scale) / 2 (new 1-6 scale), or equivalents. Qudrat or SAT scores are not mandatory but strongly recommended for shortlisting.

summary.en: A non-profit private university in Riyadh with AACSB-accredited business and strong computing and engineering programmes taught in English. Every freshman starts with a Preparatory Year.
summary.ka: არაკომერციული კერძო უნივერსიტეტი რიადში, AACSB-ის აკრედიტაციის მქონე ბიზნეს სკოლით და ძლიერი კომპიუტინგისა და ინჟინერიის პროგრამებით ინგლისურ ენაზე. ყველა პირველკურსელი მოსამზადებელი წლით იწყებს.
summary.ar: جامعة خاصة غير ربحية في الرياض، كلية الأعمال فيها معتمدة من AACSB، ولها برامج قوية في الحوسبة والهندسة تُدرَّس بالإنجليزية. يبدأ كل طالب جديد بالسنة التحضيرية.

about.en:
Prince Sultan University, founded in 1999 as Saudi Arabia's first private university, has colleges of engineering, computer and information sciences, business, law, architecture and design, and humanities, with separate male and female campuses in Riyadh. Most degrees are taught in English.

High-school graduates are admitted to the Preparatory Year Program and then progress to their major. Applicants need a school certificate (with Saudi equivalency), an English score and, ideally, Qudrat or SAT results. Fees are per credit hour, and scholarships are a separate application after admission.

deadline_note: Alfaisal Office of International Students & Exchange: all international applications must be submitted no later than 31 May (applies to Fall 2027 entry).

aid_intl.en: International applicants must show a bank balance of at least SAR 150,000 for the first year and pay a SAR 100,000 deposit (credited to first-year tuition) after acceptance before visa processing; merit scholarships are mainly for students already in the Kingdom.

tests.en: International applicants submit transcripts sent directly by the school, passport, financial documentation and English/aptitude scores as listed on the OISE page. Application fee SAR 600.

summary.en: A private, non-profit research university in Riyadh founded by the King Faisal Foundation, best known for medicine, engineering and business taught in English. International applications close on 31 May.
summary.ka: კერძო არაკომერციული კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი რიადში, დაარსებული მეფე ფეისალის ფონდის მიერ; ცნობილია მედიცინით, ინჟინერიითა და ბიზნესით ინგლისურ ენაზე. საერთაშორისო განაცხადების ვადაა 31 მაისი.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية خاصة غير ربحية في الرياض أسستها مؤسسة الملك فيصل الخيرية، تشتهر بالطب والهندسة والأعمال باللغة الإنجليزية. تُغلق طلبات الطلاب الدوليين في 31 مايو.

about.en:
Alfaisal University opened in 2002 on the King Faisal Foundation's campus in Riyadh and is accredited by the Saudi Ministry of Education and NCAAA. Its colleges of medicine, engineering, business, pharmacy and science teach in English with many international faculty, and the medical school is among the most selective in the Kingdom.

Students applying from outside Saudi Arabia work with the Office of International Students & Exchange: transcripts must come directly from the school, and applicants must show SAR 150,000 in a bank account and pay a SAR 100,000 deposit after acceptance before the visa is processed. Plan finances carefully before applying.

aid_intl.en: International students admitted from abroad are typically admitted on Saudi government scholarships through the Study in Saudi Arabia platform (benefits set by the Ministry).

tests.en: English-taught colleges require IELTS 5.0 or equivalent. International curricula accepted with Saudi equivalency: SAT I 1000/1600 or ACT 22/36 for US-system graduates; IGCSE/AS-level or IB HL subjects matched to the programme (biology and chemistry for health, maths and physics for science/engineering).

summary.en: A large public university in Abha in the Asir highlands, admitting international students through Saudi Arabia's national "Study in Saudi Arabia" platform. English-taught colleges ask for IELTS 5.0.
summary.ka: დიდი საჯარო უნივერსიტეტი აბჰაში, ასირის მთიანეთში, რომელიც საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს საუდის არაბეთის ეროვნული პლატფორმით "Study in Saudi Arabia" იღებს. ინგლისურენოვან ფაკულტეტებზე IELTS 5.0-ია საჭირო.
summary.ar: جامعة حكومية كبيرة في أبها بمنطقة عسير، تقبل الطلاب الدوليين عبر منصة "ادرس في السعودية" الوطنية. تشترط الكليات التي تدرّس بالإنجليزية IELTS 5.0.

about.en:
King Khalid University was formed in 1998 from branches of Imam Muhammad bin Saud and King Saud universities and now serves tens of thousands of students across the Asir region. It has medicine, dentistry, engineering, computer science, science, business, Sharia and languages colleges, with English used in health, science and engineering programmes.

International applicants apply through the Study in Saudi Arabia platform and must have a secondary certificate recognised as equivalent to the Saudi one. The university's international students page sets curriculum-specific rules (SAT/ACT, IGCSE/AS-level, IB) and an IELTS 5.0 minimum for English-taught colleges.

platform: Unified National Exams (Georgian citizens); direct application to TSU (foreign citizens)
deadline_note: Georgian school-leavers enter through the Unified National Exams (registration usually opens in spring; 2027 dates not yet announced by NAEC). Foreign citizens apply directly to TSU; no fixed date is published on the international page.

tuition_intl.note: TSU tuition page: 1,125 GEL per semester for all educational programmes (payable in instalments). Confirm the fee for English-taught programmes for foreign citizens with TSU.

aid_intl.en: Georgian citizens can win state study grants (50-100%) through the Unified National Exams and apply for TSU scholarships; foreign students mainly self-fund.

tests.en: Georgian citizens: Unified National Exams. Foreign citizens or Georgians educated abroad: document review, with an exam or interview if the faculty requires it; English-taught programmes require an English level certificate. Then recognition of your school certificate by the National Center for Educational Quality Enhancement and a Ministry of Education decree.

summary.en: Georgia's oldest and largest university (founded 1918), ranked in the QS 951-1000 band. Tuition is 1,125 GEL per semester; Georgians enter through the national exams and foreigners apply directly.
summary.ka: საქართველოს უძველესი და უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი (დაარსდა 1918 წელს), QS 2026-ის რეიტინგში 951-1000 ჯგუფშია. სწავლის საფასური სემესტრში 1 125 ლარია; ქართველი აბიტურიენტები ეროვნული გამოცდებით აბარებენ, უცხოელები კი პირდაპირ.
summary.ar: أقدم جامعات جورجيا وأكبرها (تأسست عام 1918)، وتقع ضمن فئة 951-1000 في تصنيف QS 2026. الرسوم 1,125 لاري للفصل الدراسي؛ يلتحق الجورجيون عبر الامتحانات الوطنية ويتقدم الأجانب مباشرة.

about.en:
Founded in 1918 by Ivane Javakhishvili, TSU is the country's flagship comprehensive university with seven faculties: exact and natural sciences, humanities, social and political sciences, psychology and education, economics and business, medicine, and law. It has a large research base, about 400 international partner universities and exchange links across Europe.

Georgian school-leavers are admitted through the Unified National Exams and can receive state grants. Foreign citizens (and Georgians who studied abroad) apply to TSU with their documents; after an exam or interview where needed, TSU issues a letter of consent, the national agency recognises the school certificate, and the Ministry's decree completes enrolment. English-medium options exist, notably in medicine.

platform: Unified National Exams (Georgian citizens); Ilia online application (international)
deadline_note: International admissions open twice a year (Fall and Spring); the Spring 2026-27 list of open programmes is on the degree-seeking applicants page. Georgian citizens apply through the Unified National Exams (2027 dates not yet announced).

aid_intl.en: Georgians admitted through the national exams can choose fully state-funded bachelor's programmes, improve partial grants via the grant-improvement exam, and compete for a 1,000 GEL Ilia scholarship for top first-years in some faculties.

tests.en: International applicants to English-taught programmes need CEFR B2 English (international certificate, a medium-of-instruction letter, or Ilia's online B2 test). Programme entrance exams (English, maths, physics, biology or chemistry) may be held online via Zoom. Application fee USD 150 after preliminary approval (can be waived if you handle recognition yourself).

summary.en: A reform-minded public research university in Tbilisi with a liberal-arts model and about 150 new international students a year. International admission opens twice a year, with B2 English required for English-taught degrees.
summary.ka: რეფორმებზე ორიენტირებული საჯარო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი თბილისში ლიბერალური განათლების მოდელით; ყოველწლიურად დაახლოებით 150 ახალი საერთაშორისო სტუდენტი ირიცხება. უცხოელთა მიღება წელიწადში ორჯერ ხდება, ინგლისურენოვან პროგრამებზე B2 დონეა საჭირო.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية حكومية إصلاحية التوجه في تبليسي تعتمد نموذج الفنون الحرة، ويلتحق بها نحو 150 طالباً دولياً جديداً كل عام. يُفتح قبول الطلاب الدوليين مرتين سنوياً، ويُشترط مستوى B2 في الإنجليزية للبرامج المدرَّسة بها.

about.en:
Ilia State University was created in 2006 by merging several Tbilisi institutions and is known for its research institutes (ecology, neuroscience, astrophysics at the Abastumani Observatory) and a flexible, liberal-arts-style bachelor's structure. Around 150 international students enrol each year, and the university runs summer schools, Erasmus+ exchanges and a buddy programme.

International applicants submit an online application, get feedback within about a week, sit an exam or interview if required, then Ilia's office can handle translation and recognition of documents through the national agency before enrolment and the visa invitation. Georgian citizens enter through the Unified National Exams, with fully state-funded programmes available.

about.en:
KIU welcomed its first students in autumn 2020 on a new campus in Kutaisi, Georgia's second city. It is a public university created under a special law and funded by the international charity foundation Cartu, which is investing over 1 billion euros; its operating model was developed with TUM, whose former president Wolfgang A. Herrmann is KIU's honorary president. Partnerships with the University of Naples Federico II and the University of Bamberg support dual and double degrees.

Bachelor's programmes in computer science, management, mathematics (AI, scientific computing, financial mathematics) and design are all taught in English, in a modern residential campus. Georgian students apply via the national exams; international students apply directly and can apply for KIU scholarships for foreign citizens.

about.en:
IBSU is an accredited private university on the outskirts of Tbilisi offering 26 English-taught degree programmes across bachelor's, master's and doctoral levels. Bachelor's options include business administration (accounting, finance, management, marketing, tourism), economics, architecture, computer science, graphic design, international relations, American studies and English philology, plus a medical doctor programme.

Foreign applicants fill in an electronic form and email it with their documents; the international office uploads them to the national agency for recognition, and the student then applies for a Georgian residence permit within three months of arrival. Fees are moderate by international standards, and partial scholarships reduce them further.

summary.ka: კერძო უნივერსიტეტი კახა ბენდუქიძის კამპუსზე თბილისში, ცნობილი ბიზნესით, მათემატიკითა და კომპიუტერული მეცნიერებებით და სამართლით. სტუდენტების უმეტესობა ერთიანი ეროვნული გამოცდებით აბარებს.

about.en:
The Free University of Tbilisi shares the Kakha Bendukidze Campus with the Agricultural University of Georgia and offers bachelor's, master's, doctoral and non-degree programmes. It is known for its business school, a demanding mathematics and computer science school, a law school, and research units such as the Institute of Asia and Africa and a cognitive neuroscience institute.

Applicants usually enter through the national exams; the Applicants section explains enrolment, financing, competitions and open-door days, and the university runs introductory programmes for prospective students.

Chinese Government (CSC) Scholarship via Chinese embassies.

about.en:
Founded in 1896, SJTU is a leading Chinese research university with particular strength in engineering, medicine and naval architecture. International undergraduates can study engineering entirely in English through the Global College, which grew out of the University of Michigan-SJTU Joint Institute, with majors such as mechanical, electrical and computer engineering and civil engineering.

Applicants submit the new CSCA maths test plus SAT/ACT, A-level or IB results, an English test, two recommendations, transcripts and a RMB 100,000 financial guarantee. Strong applicants can win scholarships ranging from 25% tuition to a full four-year package with monthly living and housing allowances.

about.en:
NTU, founded in 1928, is Taiwan's leading comprehensive research university, with eleven colleges and close links to the island's semiconductor and technology industry. Many undergraduate courses are taught in Mandarin, though the university lists English-taught programmes and offers Chinese language study for international students.

International degree students apply online in rounds; the first round for September 2027 runs until 5 November 2026. Compare departments carefully, as language and document requirements differ, and look at Taiwan government scholarships alongside NTU's own awards.

about.en:
The University of Tokyo, founded in 1877, is Japan's leading research university. Its new UTokyo College of Design, taking its first students in September 2027, combines design approaches with knowledge from across UTokyo's disciplines to tackle complex social problems; teaching is in English, and students complete their whole degree within the college.

Route B is designed for international-curriculum students: you submit English-language documents, an accepted standardized test or qualification and an English test, and shortlisted applicants are interviewed online in English. The needs-based scholarship covers tuition and living costs (JPY 2.4 million a year) plus a flight, which makes this one of the most accessible ways into UTokyo for international students.

about.en:
Founded in 1907, Tohoku University was one of Japan's original imperial universities and is internationally known for materials science, metals research, physics and engineering. Its Gateway College offers English-taught undergraduate courses with April and October entry, alongside its larger Japanese-taught faculties.

International applicants to English-taught courses go through a comprehensive selection based on documents; those aiming for Japanese-taught programmes take the EJU and the university's own exam. Fees are the standard national rate, far below most Western universities, and hardship-based fee waivers exist.

summary.ar: أشهر كلية فنون حرة في اليابان، تقع غرب طوكيو، وتدرّس باللغتين اليابانية والإنجليزية. يحتاج المتقدمون باللغة الإنجليزية إلى IELTS 6.5 أو TOEFL 79، ويُفتح التقديم لدفعة سبتمبر 2027 في يناير 2027.

about.en:
ICU was founded in 1953 as a bilingual liberal-arts university and lets students choose from 31 majors after exploring widely in their first years. Students without Japanese join the Japanese Language Programme while taking English-taught courses, and graduate fluent in both languages.

Applicants with international curricula apply in English for April or September entry. Test scores matter, but ICU says all documents are equally important, and it publishes average SAT/ACT/IB/TOEFL scores of successful applicants to help you gauge your chances.

deadline_note: BUE admissions follow the Egyptian Council of Private Universities cycle (summer, after school results); no fixed 2027 date published yet.

tuition_intl.note: 2026-27 international tuition by category: Health GBP 2,412 (nursing) to 12,700 (dentistry); Technology & Engineering GBP 6,846-11,000; Social Sciences GBP 3,294-10,500; Languages GBP 2,405-4,700.

aid_intl.en: Academic scholarships on tuition for top school grades: 20% (category B), 30% (A), 40% (A*); dentistry 15-30%; English and Chinese 30-50%. Other scholarships listed on the fees page.

tests.en: Admission follows Egyptian Council of Private Universities rules plus BUE criteria. American-diploma applicants: minimum SAT1/EST1 800 or ACT 14 (EST2 900 for subject tests), and 520 in SAT/EST English; school transcripts stamped by the relevant ministries.

summary.en: A private university near Cairo whose students earn both a BUE degree and a UK-validated award. International tuition runs from about GBP 2,400 to 12,700 a year, with merit scholarships of 20-40%.
summary.ka: კერძო უნივერსიტეტი კაიროსთან, სადაც სტუდენტები იღებენ როგორც BUE-ს, ისე ბრიტანეთის უნივერსიტეტის მიერ ვალიდირებულ დიპლომს. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტების საფასური წელიწადში დაახლ. 2 400-დან 12 700 ფუნტამდეა, აკადემიური სტიპენდიები 20-40%-ს ფარავს.
summary.ar: جامعة خاصة قرب القاهرة يحصل طلابها على شهادة من BUE وأخرى معتمدة من جامعة بريطانية. تتراوح الرسوم الدولية بين نحو 2,400 و12,700 جنيه إسترليني سنوياً، مع منح تفوق بنسبة 20-40%.

about.en:
The British University in Egypt was set up in 2005 under a UK-Egypt memorandum and offers programmes validated by British universities, so graduates receive two awards: one from the BUE and one from the validating UK university. Faculties include dentistry, pharmacy, nursing, engineering, informatics and computer science, business, economics and political science, mass communication and arts and humanities.

International students pay fees set in pounds sterling by programme category, and academic scholarships of up to 40% (50% for some language programmes) apply automatically to strong school results. American-diploma applicants need SAT/EST or ACT minimums and certified transcripts.

summary.ar: جامعة مصرية خاصة أُسست بالتعاون مع جامعات ألمانية شريكة، تدرّس بالإنجليزية مع تعلّم الألمانية إلزامياً. تبلغ الرسوم الدولية نحو 6,000-7,500 يورو سنوياً.

about.en:
The German University in Cairo opened in 2003 with support from the universities of Ulm and Stuttgart and the German academic community. It is known for engineering (especially mechatronics and information engineering), pharmacy and biotechnology, management technology, applied arts and architecture, and runs a Berlin campus for study periods in Germany.

Courses are taught in English while every student learns German, which opens doors to internships and master's study in Germany. International applicants apply online and should confirm certificate requirements with the international counselling service.

summary.en: A private American-style university in Kuwait focused on engineering and business, ranked in the QS top 600. Entry is based on the school average and AUM's own English and maths tests.
summary.ka: კერძო ამერიკული ტიპის უნივერსიტეტი ქუვეითში, ორიენტირებული ინჟინერიასა და ბიზნესზე, QS-ის საუკეთესო 600-ში. მიღება ეფუძნება სასკოლო საშუალო ქულას და AUM-ის საკუთარ ინგლისურისა და მათემატიკის ტესტებს.
summary.ar: جامعة خاصة على النمط الأمريكي في الكويت تركز على الهندسة والأعمال، ضمن أفضل 600 في QS. يعتمد القبول على المعدل المدرسي واختبارَي AUM في الإنجليزية والرياضيات.

about.en:
AUM opened in 2008 in Egaila, south of Kuwait City. It offers bachelor's degrees in engineering (including petroleum, mechanical, electrical, industrial and computer engineering) and business, taught in English and accredited by Kuwait's Private Universities Council.

Applicants submit a ministry-certified school certificate and take AUM's English and maths skill assessments; students below the English threshold can retake once. Most students are Kuwaiti or residents of Kuwait; non-residents should contact admissions about visa sponsorship.

summary.en: A US-accredited (WSCUC) English-medium university in Yerevan, affiliated with the University of California. Early Admission for Fall 2027 closes on 15 January 2027, and international students can get merit scholarships of up to 50%.
summary.ka: აშშ-ში აკრედიტებული (WSCUC) ინგლისურენოვანი უნივერსიტეტი ერევანში, კალიფორნიის უნივერსიტეტთან აფილირებული. 2027 წლის შემოდგომის ადრეული მიღების ვადაა 2027 წლის 15 იანვარი; საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს 50%-მდე სტიპენდია შეუძლიათ მიიღონ.

about.en:
AUA was founded in 1991, the year of Armenia's independence, and is accredited in the United States by the WASC Senior College and University Commission. Teaching is entirely in English, with bachelor's programmes in computer science, data science, business, engineering sciences, politics and governance, English and communications, and environmental and nutrition sciences, on a compact campus in central Yerevan.

Admission is holistic and competitive. Applicants submit transcripts, test scores or sit AUA's entrance exams, an application fee and passport; international admits must then be approved by the Armenian ministry. For students from the South Caucasus and the Middle East it is an affordable route to an American-accredited degree close to home.

about.en:
Yerevan State University is Armenia's flagship public university, with faculties ranging from physics, mathematics and informatics to international relations, law, economics and oriental studies. It has strong traditions in the natural sciences and a large network of international partners.

Admission is handled by the YSU Admissions Committee during a spring window. International and diaspora applicants should check the language of instruction for their programme, since most bachelor's programmes are taught in Armenian.

summary.en: One of Japan's two leading universities (QS #57), with the Kyoto iUP programme that teaches international students Japanese before they enter a regular faculty, backed by fee waivers and monthly scholarships. Applications run 2 November to 3 December 2026.

about.en:
Kyoto University, founded in 1897, is famous for its free-spirited research culture and a long list of Nobel laureates in physics, chemistry and medicine. Most undergraduate teaching is in Japanese, which is why the Kyoto iUP route exists: admitted students first complete intensive Japanese preparation (the programme starts in October) and then join faculties such as engineering, science, agriculture, economics, law or education.

Kyoto iUP is designed for strong students who do not yet speak Japanese, and comes with financial support including fee waivers and monthly scholarships. Read the October 2027 guidelines carefully: the online application window is short (2 November to 3 December 2026).

summary.ar: جامعة خاصة مرموقة في وسط طوكيو تقدم عدة برامج بالإنجليزية، أبرزها كلية الدراسات الليبرالية الدولية. تقبل SAT وACT وIB وA-level والعديد من الامتحانات الوطنية.

about.en:
Waseda, founded in 1882, is one of Japan's two leading private universities, with a large international student body and alumni across politics, business and media. Its English-based undergraduate options include the School of International Liberal Studies (SILS), the Global Studies in Japanese Cultures Program, and English tracks in political science and economics, social sciences and engineering.

Applicants submit documents online according to their school's guidelines, using whichever recognised exam results they hold. Waseda handles the Certificate of Eligibility for visa purposes for admitted students abroad, and some applicants receive reserved scholarships at the admission stage.

summary.en: Malaysia's top-ranked private university, near Kuala Lumpur, known for hospitality, business and design. Most degrees start in February, April or September.
summary.ka: მალაიზიის ყველაზე მაღალრეიტინგული კერძო უნივერსიტეტი კუალა-ლუმპურთან ახლოს, ცნობილი სტუმართმოყვარეობის ინდუსტრიით, ბიზნესითა და დიზაინით. პროგრამების უმეტესობა თებერვალში, აპრილში ან სექტემბერში იწყება.

about.en:
Taylor's University, on a lakeside campus in Subang Jaya, grew from a college founded in 1969 into one of Asia's strongest private universities. It is known for hospitality and tourism management, business, architecture and design, and also offers computing, pharmacy, medicine, law and communication, plus an American Degree Transfer Program.

With several intakes a year, English-taught courses and moderate costs compared with Western universities, it suits students who want an international environment in Southeast Asia. Fees vary by programme and are listed in the official fee schedules.

about.en:
Al Akhawayn University opened in 1995 in the mountain town of Ifrane and teaches in English on an American-style curriculum, with schools of business, science and engineering, and humanities and social sciences. It is accredited in the US (NECHE) and has many exchange partners abroad.

International applicants submit documents and English scores through the Office of Admissions and Outreach well before the 31 May Fall deadline; all students take placement writing tests. It is a distinctive option for students who want a US-style liberal-arts education in North Africa.

deadline_note: ALU admits several intakes a year (e.g. International Business & Trade only in May and September); check the application guide for the next intake's deadline.

aid_intl.en: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at ALU: full-ride scholarships for eligible students (priority groups include students with disabilities); limited slots per intake, with grants for others who show need.

tests.en: Secondary certificate with minimum passes (e.g. Rwanda ACSE 50% overall or equivalent); application guide lists country-specific equivalents.

summary.en: A pan-African university in Kigali built around leadership, entrepreneurship and mission-driven learning. Mastercard Foundation full-ride scholarships are available for eligible African students.
summary.ka: პანაფრიკული უნივერსიტეტი კიგალიში, ორიენტირებული ლიდერობაზე, მეწარმეობასა და მისიაზე დაფუძნებულ სწავლებაზე. შესაბამისი აფრიკელი სტუდენტებისთვის ხელმისაწვდომია Mastercard Foundation-ის სრული სტიპენდიები.
summary.ar: جامعة أفريقية شاملة في كيغالي تقوم على القيادة وريادة الأعمال والتعلّم القائم على الرسالة. تتوفر منح Mastercard Foundation الكاملة للطلاب الأفارقة المؤهلين.

about.en:
African Leadership University was founded to develop ethical, entrepreneurial leaders for Africa. Its Kigali campus offers bachelor's degrees such as International Business & Trade, Software Engineering and Entrepreneurial Leadership, taught in English through project-based, peer-led learning tied to "missions" on major global challenges.

The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at ALU provides full-ride scholarships, and applicants who miss a scholarship slot can still be considered for grants or study self-funded. Intakes run several times a year.

scholarships.name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at ALU

deadline_note: UCT: applications for 2027 study opened 1 April 2026 and closed 31 July 2026 (no late applications). The 2028 cycle is expected to open around April 2027; check the application procedure page.

aid_intl.en: International and refugee scholarships are listed by UCT; fees for international students are in the official fees handbook.

tests.en: Admission based on school-leaving results and UCT's eligibility rules for foreign qualifications; application fee R100 (SADC) or R300 (applicants from outside the SADC region).

summary.en: Africa's highest-ranked university (QS #150), on the slopes of Table Mountain. Applications for each year close at the end of July of the previous year, so 2028 entry is the next realistic intake.
summary.ka: აფრიკის ყველაზე მაღალრეიტინგული უნივერსიტეტი (QS 2026 — 150-ე) მაგიდის მთის ფერდობზე. განაცხადები წინა წლის ივლისის ბოლოს იხურება, ამიტომ შემდეგი რეალური ნაკადი 2028 წელია.
summary.ar: أعلى جامعة تصنيفاً في أفريقيا (المرتبة 150 في QS 2026)، على سفوح جبل الطاولة. تُغلق الطلبات في نهاية يوليو من العام السابق، لذا فالدفعة الواقعية التالية هي 2028.

about.en:
The University of Cape Town, founded in 1829, is South Africa's oldest university and a leading research institution in health sciences, commerce, engineering, law and the sciences. Its campus sits on the slopes of Devil's Peak, and the academic year starts in February.

Applications for a given year open on 1 April and close on 31 July of the year before, with no late applications. International applicants should check the eligibility rules for their school qualification, the international fees handbook and the international and refugee scholarship listings.

deadline_note: Foreign applicants enrol in the Ciclo Básico Común (CBC) during UBA's published enrolment periods (cbc.uba.ar/inscripciones); no single fixed deadline is shown on the foreign-students page.

aid_intl.en: UBA runs undergraduate scholarship programmes (Becas de grado); check current rules on fees for foreign students with UBA.

tests.en: No entrance exam for foreign applicants: everyone starts with the Ciclo Básico Común (CBC), the first cycle of all degrees. Applicants whose school diploma was issued in a non-Spanish-speaking country must present a Spanish certificate at C1 level (SIELE Global C1 or UBA's Advanced Spanish certificate). School diplomas must be legalised/apostilled.

summary.en: Latin America's highest-ranked Spanish-speaking university (QS #84), a huge public university in Buenos Aires with no entrance exam: all students start with the Ciclo Básico Común. Non-Spanish-speaking applicants need Spanish at C1.
summary.ka: ლათინური ამერიკის ყველაზე მაღალრეიტინგული ესპანურენოვანი უნივერსიტეტი (QS 2026 — 84-ე), დიდი საჯარო უნივერსიტეტი ბუენოს-აირესში მისაღები გამოცდის გარეშე: ყველა სტუდენტი Ciclo Básico Común-ით იწყებს. არაესპანურენოვანი ქვეყნიდან ჩამოსულებს C1 დონის ესპანური სჭირდებათ.
summary.ar: أعلى جامعة ناطقة بالإسبانية تصنيفاً في أمريكا اللاتينية (المرتبة 84 في QS 2026)، جامعة حكومية ضخمة في بوينس آيرس بلا امتحان قبول: يبدأ الجميع بالدورة الأساسية المشتركة (CBC). يحتاج القادمون من بلدان غير ناطقة بالإسبانية إلى مستوى C1.

about.en:
Founded in 1821, UBA has 13 faculties and hundreds of thousands of students, and counts several Nobel laureates and many Latin American leaders among its alumni. It is especially known for medicine, law, economics, engineering, architecture and the exact sciences.

There is no admission exam: foreign applicants register for the Ciclo Básico Común, a common first year whose subjects depend on the chosen degree, and continue to their faculty after passing it. Teaching is in Spanish, so students from non-Spanish-speaking countries must prove C1 Spanish before enrolling.

platform: Fuvest entrance exam or Sisu (ENEM); PEC-G for partner countries
deadline_note: Fuvest registration for the vestibular usually opens in the second half of the year; dates for 2028 entry are published by Fuvest. PEC-G applications go through Brazilian embassies.

tuition_intl.note: USP undergraduate courses are free of charge (public university).

aid_intl.en: Tuition-free. Students from partner countries in Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean can apply via the PEC-G government programme.

tests.en: International applicants can sit the Fuvest vestibular (entrance exam, in Portuguese) or enter through Sisu using ENEM scores; PEC-G for partner countries; transfers only into unfilled places. Most teaching is in Portuguese.

summary.en: Brazil's largest and highest-ranked university (QS #108), with free undergraduate courses taught mainly in Portuguese. Entry is through the Fuvest entrance exam, ENEM/Sisu or the PEC-G programme.
summary.ka: ბრაზილიის უდიდესი და ყველაზე მაღალრეიტინგული უნივერსიტეტი (QS 2026 — 108-ე), უფასო საბაკალავრო სწავლებით, ძირითადად პორტუგალიურ ენაზე. ჩარიცხვა ხდება Fuvest-ის გამოცდით, ENEM/Sisu-თ ან PEC-G პროგრამით.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعات البرازيل وأعلاها تصنيفاً (المرتبة 108 في QS 2026)، ودراسة البكالوريوس فيها مجانية وبالبرتغالية غالباً. القبول عبر امتحان Fuvest أو ENEM/Sisu أو برنامج PEC-G.

about.en:
The University of São Paulo, founded in 1934, is Latin America's leading research university, with campuses in São Paulo and several other cities in the state. Its schools of medicine, engineering (Poli), law, economics and business (FEA) and architecture are among the most prestigious in Brazil.

Undergraduate courses are free and last four to six years. International students can take the Fuvest vestibular in Portuguese, use ENEM scores through Sisu, or, if from a partner country, apply through PEC-G. Strong Portuguese is essential, since almost all teaching is in Portuguese.

Portuguese language certificate (teaching and exams in Portuguese)

name.en: UNSW Sydney (University of New South Wales)

platform: Direct (UNSW Applicant Portal) or UNSW agent
deadline_note: UNSW admissions info: applications from offshore applicants for Term 1 2027 stay open until 15 Nov 2026; offers for applicants from International Student Award countries are issued weekly, others in offer rounds. Later 2027 terms remain open. UNSW introduces a new academic calendar from 2028.

aid_intl.en: International undergraduate scholarships (including the International Student Award for eligible countries) are listed on the UNSW scholarships pages; awards consider leadership and extracurriculars as well as grades.

tests.en: English: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (min 6.0 in each band) or TOEFL iBT 90 (min 23 writing, 22 reading, listening, speaking); PTE Academic and C1 Advanced also accepted; some degrees require more. IELTS Online not accepted; the new TOEFL format is under review.

summary.en: One of Australia's top universities (QS #20), strongest in engineering, computing, business and law. International applicants use the UNSW Applicant Portal; offshore Term 1 2027 applications close 15 November 2026.
summary.ka: ავსტრალიის ერთ-ერთი საუკეთესო უნივერსიტეტი (QS 2026 — მე-20), განსაკუთრებით ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, კომპიუტინგში, ბიზნესსა და სამართალში. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტები UNSW Applicant Portal-ით აბარებენ; 2027 წლის პირველი ტერმის ვადა საზღვარგარეთიდან 2026 წლის 15 ნოემბერია.
summary.ar: من أفضل جامعات أستراليا (المرتبة 20 في QS 2026)، أقوى مجالاتها الهندسة والحوسبة والأعمال والقانون. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون عبر بوابة UNSW، وينتهي التقديم من الخارج للفصل الأول 2027 في 15 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
UNSW, founded in 1949 in Kensington, Sydney, is a research-intensive member of Australia's Group of Eight, known for engineering, computer science, business, law, medicine and the built environment, and for strong industry and startup links. It currently runs three terms a year, moving to a new academic calendar from 2028.

International undergraduates apply directly through the UNSW Applicant Portal (or a UNSW agent) using IB, A-level, US or other national qualifications set out in the 2027 entry requirements. Apply early: offshore Term 1 2027 applications close 15 November 2026, and offers are prioritised by academic merit and place availability.

platform: Direct (University of Sydney online application) or agent
deadline_note: International applications are accepted year-round, but closing dates vary by course (see the application dates page and each course page); apply at least 6-8 weeks before the start to allow for the visa. Scholarship deadlines are separate.

aid_intl.en: Over A$135 million in scholarships awarded each year; international scholarships are listed on the University's international scholarships page, and around 200 Australia Awards recipients are supported annually.

tests.en: Standard English requirement: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0 (some courses higher); TOEFL iBT (Australia version, Home Edition not accepted), PTE and LanguageCert accepted via the concordance table. Tests must be under two years old at course start.

summary.en: Australia's first university (QS #25), a sandstone campus in inner Sydney with strong medicine, law, business and engineering. International students apply directly year-round, with course-specific closing dates.
summary.ka: ავსტრალიის პირველი უნივერსიტეტი (QS 2026 — 25-ე), ქვიშაქვის კამპუსით სიდნეის ცენტრში და ძლიერი მედიცინით, სამართლით, ბიზნესითა და ინჟინერიით. უცხოელები პირდაპირ აბარებენ მთელი წლის განმავლობაში, ვადები კურსზეა დამოკიდებული.
summary.ar: أول جامعة في أستراليا (المرتبة 25 في QS 2026)، حرمها الحجري التاريخي في قلب سيدني، قوية في الطب والقانون والأعمال والهندسة. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون مباشرة على مدار العام مع مواعيد إغلاق تختلف حسب البرنامج.

about.en:
Founded in 1850, the University of Sydney is Australia's oldest university and a member of the Group of Eight. Its Camperdown/Darlington campus hosts a broad range of faculties, with particular strength in medicine and health, law, business, engineering, architecture and veterinary science.

International students check the entry requirements on each course page, apply online (directly or via an agent), accept the offer and pay first-semester fees to receive a Confirmation of Enrolment for the visa. The standard English requirement is IELTS 6.5 with no band below 6.0.

label.en: Proof of funds (for the student visa)

deadline_note: Tec's undergraduate page lists dates for August 2026; August 2027 dates "will be available soon".

aid_intl.en: Scholarships and educational loans for undergraduates are listed at tec.mx/es/profesional/becas (mostly need- and merit-based).

tests.en: Academic Aptitude Test (PAA); native English speakers may submit SAT or ACT instead (Tec code 0843). English: Tec placement exam or TOEFL iBT, Cambridge B2 First/PET or Pearson certificate. Documents: birth certificate, transcript with GPA, passport or ID.

sat.note: Accepted instead of PAA for native English speakers (code 0843)

summary.en: Mexico's leading private university (QS #187), with campuses across the country and strong engineering and business schools. International applicants take the PAA aptitude test (or SAT/ACT if native English speakers).
summary.ka: მექსიკის წამყვანი კერძო უნივერსიტეტი (QS 2026 — 187-ე), კამპუსებით მთელ ქვეყანაში და ძლიერი საინჟინრო და ბიზნეს სკოლებით. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტები PAA ტესტს აბარებენ (ან SAT/ACT-ს, თუ ინგლისური მშობლიური ენაა).
summary.ar: أبرز جامعة خاصة في المكسيك (المرتبة 187 في QS 2026)، لها فروع في أنحاء البلاد وكليات قوية للهندسة والأعمال. يجتاز المتقدمون الدوليون اختبار القدرات PAA (أو SAT/ACT للناطقين بالإنجليزية).

about.en:
Tecnológico de Monterrey was founded in 1943 by Monterrey business leaders and now runs campuses across Mexico. Its Tec21 model is built around challenge-based learning with companies, and it is highly regarded for engineering, business, computing, architecture and entrepreneurship.

International students apply through the online Tec Application with school transcripts and identity documents, then sit the PAA aptitude test (or send SAT/ACT if English is their first language) and prove English level. Most teaching is in Spanish, with some programmes and courses in English.

deadline_note: International applications are assessed on a rolling basis; check programme-specific closing dates on the UQ admissions pages.

aid_intl.en: UQ scholarships for international students are listed at scholarships.uq.edu.au.

tests.en: Minimum English for most programmes: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in every band (IELTS One Skill Retake accepted with the original test; IELTS Online not recognised); equivalent TOEFL/PTE scores per UQ's table; some programmes need more. Students below the level can take UQ English pathways.

summary.en: A Group of Eight research university in Brisbane (QS #42 in 2026), strong in life sciences, engineering and environmental science. International students need IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 in each band for most degrees.
summary.ka: Group of Eight-ის კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ბრისბენში (QS 2026 — 42-ე), ძლიერი სიცოცხლის მეცნიერებებში, ინჟინერიასა და გარემოს მეცნიერებაში. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს უმეტეს პროგრამაზე IELTS 6.5 (თითო კომპონენტში 6.0) სჭირდებათ.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية من مجموعة الثماني في بريزبن (المرتبة 42 في QS 2026)، قوية في علوم الحياة والهندسة والعلوم البيئية. يحتاج الطلاب الدوليون إلى IELTS 6.5 مع 6.0 في كل مهارة لمعظم البرامج.

about.en:
The University of Queensland, founded in 1909, has its main campus at St Lucia on the Brisbane River and is a member of Australia's Group of Eight. It is internationally known for biotechnology, life sciences, environmental science, engineering, business and medicine, and for research commercialisation.

International undergraduates apply online with their school results and English test, and can enter through UQ English pathway programmes if they fall short. Brisbane's lower living costs compared with Sydney and Melbourne make UQ a popular choice.

platform: Unified National Exams (Georgian citizens); GTU international online registration (foreign citizens)
deadline_note: Georgians enter through the Unified National Exams (2027 dates to be announced by NAEC). Foreign citizens register online with GTU's International Admissions Office; no fixed deadline is published on the enrolment procedure page.

aid_intl.en: Georgian citizens can receive state study grants via the national exams.

tests.en: Foreign citizens: online registration, consent letter from GTU, recognition of foreign education by the National Center for Educational Quality Enhancement, then a rector's order completes enrolment and visa documents are issued. Foreign-language (English-taught) programmes are listed on GTU's admissions site.

summary.en: Georgia's main technical university in Tbilisi, ranked in the QS 1001-1200 band, covering engineering, IT, architecture and energy. Foreign citizens apply online and go through state recognition of their school certificate.
summary.ka: საქართველოს მთავარი ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი თბილისში, QS 2026-ის 1001-1200 ჯგუფში: ინჟინერია, ინფორმატიკა, არქიტექტურა და ენერგეტიკა. უცხოელები ონლაინ რეგისტრირდებიან და სასკოლო ატესტატის სახელმწიფო აღიარებას გადიან.
summary.ar: الجامعة التقنية الرئيسية في جورجيا بتبليسي، ضمن فئة 1001-1200 في QS 2026، وتشمل الهندسة وتقنية المعلومات والعمارة والطاقة. يسجل الأجانب عبر الإنترنت ويخضعون لمعادلة شهادتهم المدرسية من الجهة الحكومية.

about.en:
Georgian Technical University traces its roots to 1922 and is the country's largest engineering university, with faculties of civil engineering, power engineering, informatics and control systems, architecture, mining and geology, transportation, chemical technology and more.

Foreign applicants register online, receive a consent letter, and the national agency recognises their foreign education before GTU issues the enrolment order and visa support documents. Check the foreign-language programmes list for English-taught options.

label.en: Recognition / equivalency of your school certificate

name.en: San Diego State University Georgia (SDSU Georgia)

deadline_note: Check the SDSU Georgia degree programmes page for the next application window; no Fall 2027 date was published on the homepage.

aid_intl.en: Contact SDSU Georgia for current funding; the programme was established with partners including Georgia's Ministry of Education and the US Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC/MCA-Georgia).

tests.en: US-style admission with English proficiency required (programmes are taught in English); see SDSU Georgia admissions for details.

summary.en: A branch of the US San Diego State University in Tbilisi awarding American bachelor's degrees in civil engineering, computer engineering and computer science, taught in English.
summary.ka: აშშ-ის სან-დიეგოს სახელმწიფო უნივერსიტეტის ფილიალი თბილისში, რომელიც ამერიკულ საბაკალავრო ხარისხებს გასცემს სამოქალაქო ინჟინერიაში, კომპიუტერულ ინჟინერიასა და კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებებში; სწავლება ინგლისურადაა.
summary.ar: فرع لجامعة ولاية سان دييغو الأمريكية في تبليسي يمنح شهادات بكالوريوس أمريكية في الهندسة المدنية وهندسة الحاسوب وعلوم الحاسوب، والتدريس بالإنجليزية.

about.en:
SDSU Georgia, at 5 Kostava Street in central Tbilisi, delivers San Diego State University bachelor's degrees in Georgia. Its partners, shown on the official site, include Georgia's Ministry of Education, Georgian Technical University, Tbilisi State University, Ilia State University and the US Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCA-Georgia).

The three STEM degrees (civil engineering, computer engineering and computer science) are taught in English, which makes this a way to earn a US degree without leaving the South Caucasus.
